hgb_dynatune_governor_shift.description: Exposes dynatune hardware metrics (thermal, battery, PSI memory pressure) directly into hgb-daemon, programmatically shifting CPU governor to performance, downscaling if thermal limits approach 78°C, and tuning MGLRU memory compaction

hgb_cluster_mesh_offload.description: Dispatches heavy computational workloads (batch embeddings, LanceDB vector search, crate compilation) across a secure WireGuard/mTLS mesh to idle Firecracker microVMs on remote cluster peers with automatic failover
